title: fix(console): a record page leaves out related lists and rail entries of an object the install does not hold
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GUdk9SEEZXQX6B5hTkWx4K)_
Fixes #26988

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页上,绑定到当前安装里不存在的对象的相关列表和右栏条目不再绘制,也不再为它发 `/meta/object`、`/data` 请求。
- 为什么改:ADR-0141 之后模块对象可以真实缺席,页面却照画「Crm Quote 0 — No related records found」这类拿原始名拼出的假标题,并打出一串 404。
- 风险与回滚:只在已注册对象列表非空时裁剪,与仪表盘 `requiresObject` 同一规则;回滚即撤掉 `RecordDetailView.tsx` 里两处 `pruneUnregisteredRecordPageObjects` 调用。
- 先看:`recordPageChildObjects.ts`(裁剪函数)、`RecordDetailView.tsx`(`assignedPage` / `assignedSlots` 两个 memo)、新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.unregisteredObjectLists-26988.test.tsx`,预期 2 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `recordPageChildObjects.ts` gains `pruneUnregisteredRecordPageObjects(page, registered)`. It reads the same two arms as `recordPageChildObjects` (now shared helpers): a `record:related_list` block whose `properties.objectName` or `dataSource.object` names an object the registered list does not hold is removed; a `record:reference_rail` entry whose `objectName` does is removed, and a rail left with no entries goes with it. Only a string names an object. While the registered list is empty it returns the page untouched (the deferral `DashboardView` makes), and it is identity-preserving: a page or subtree with nothing to leave out is returned itself.
- `RecordDetailView` prunes the authored page and a slotted page's slots right where `assignedPage` / `assignedSlots` are resolved, so the effective page, the synthesized page, the composed page and the history page all read one pruned page.
- The registered list is the view's own `objects` prop, the list `deriveRelatedLists` already reads. It is not `useMetadata().objects`: that getter loads the whole registry, which the scoped record route (objectui#13046) exists to avoid. On that route `objects` is the scope: the package's objects plus every object the page binds, each asked by name.
- The child-write subscription from #26890 reads the pruned page. An object the install does not hold cannot be written, so there is nothing to watch on it.
- Derived related lists (`deriveRelatedLists`) were already safe: they come from the registered objects only.

## Tests

- `RecordDetailView.unregisteredObjectLists-26988.test.tsx` uses the real page. It has a related list bound by `objectName`, one bound by `dataSource.object`, and a rail entry, all three for absent objects, beside a registered contact list and rail entry.
  - Absent arm: no humanized name ("Crm Quote" and the others), no rows, and no data-source call or `fetch` URL names any of the three objects. The contact list and rail entry still draw and read.
  - Present arm: the same page draws all three and reads every object.
- `recordPageChildObjects.test.ts`: pins what is left out and what is kept, the deferral (an empty set prunes nothing), identity preservation, that the authored page is never mutated, and that non-string names are kept.
- Ablation: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the guard line `if (registered.size === 0) return page;` with an unconditional `return page;`. The absent-arm test went red (`expected '…' not to contain 'Crm Quote'`) and the present arm stayed green. The tool restored the file (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).

## Acceptance notes

- On a scoped record route (a full declared record page in a packaged app), the scope still asks `/meta/object/NAME` once for each name the page binds, absent ones included. That read is how the console learns the object is absent; it is the one existence check, and this PR adds none. Everything the page itself asked (each block's schema read and `/data` read) is gone.
- A tab or container whose only content was a pruned list stays, now empty. Pruning containers is not part of this card.
- `record:line_items` (`childObject`) is not pruned. It is outside this card's two arms.

## Verification

Gate readings and the head they were taken on are in the os-dev report comment on #26988.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Local: eslint on the four changed files, 0 errors; the repo-wide run is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes here, so no changeset.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
